name: Meraioth
overview: Meraioth appears in Scripture as a significant priestly figure connected to the lineage of Eleazar, highlighting the continuity of God's appointed priesthood. He is noted as an ancestor of Amariah in Ezra 7:3 and as a forefather to Seraiah, who was a leader in the house of God during Nehemiah's time (Nehemiah 11:11). Additionally, Meraioth is identified as the father of Helkai, a priest during Joiakim's era (Nehemiah 12:15), underscoring his enduring role within the priestly line serving the temple and God's covenant people.
